description.en:
Runs the MasterAvatar event script (ev42132000) for an NPC. It creates a fresh event context (subev_ctx) with room for 4 coroutines, loads the event script "data/script/event/ev42132000.nutb" (always the same script, whatever the ID) into that context (CMND_LOAD_SCRIPT) and waits for it to load. It then runs the script's Event function as a coroutine, waking it up once per frame until it has finished, and clears the context at the end. Before loading, it stores _id in subev_ctx.id and _hdl in subev_ctx.npc_hdl, so the event script can read them.
Unlike CallEvent, it does not call SYS_EVENT_STEP or the camera-control step each frame.
It is called by ie4_ev_sub_std.nut, the standard event script: its Main function picks the runner from the event type set by SetupParam (4 = CallKiznaxEvent, 5 = CallShopEvent, 9 = CallMasterAvatar, anything else = CallEvent).
Event ID, stored in subev_ctx.id for the event script.
Handle of the NPC talked to, stored in subev_ctx.npc_hdl.
